summary: Phase 1 backend + frontend fully tested. 21/21 backend tests passing (auth, projects, tasks/progress, photos with project filter). Frontend flows all working: unauth->login redirect, login, dashboard stats (1 project, $620,000, 13% avg), projects list, project detail 13% progress, roadmap with 6 stages and 4 RBS badges (all render when stages expanded), custom task add/edit/delete, project create/delete, analyzer project select + history, logout. Old test_photos.py updated to authenticate first.

integration_issues.issue: Stats momentarily render as 0/$0/0% for ~1-2s right after login before /api/projects response arrives; correct values (1, $620,000, 13%) appear after settle. Not a functional bug but a small UX flash; consider showing a loading skeleton for stat cards.

action_items: Optional polish: replace initial 0 values on Dashboard stats with a loading skeleton to avoid the flash-of-zero after login.

Optional polish: consider expanding all 6 stages by default (or persisting expansion state) on the Roadmap tab — currently only some stages are expanded initially so RBS badges/task rows in collapsed stages aren't visible without clicking.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py set_auth_cookies uses secure=False — acceptable for the preview http scheme, but ensure this flips to True (or driven by env) for production HTTPS deployment.

server.py CORS uses allow_origins='*' by default while allow_credentials=True — browsers reject that combo. Works here only because CORS_ORIGINS is not '*' in .env, but the fallback default should be a safer empty list rather than '*'.
projects.py list_projects issues an N+1-style aggregation via stage_counts_for_projects — fine at Phase 1 scale but worth watching if projects grow into hundreds.

seed.py seed_demo_project keys off is_seed:true so re-running startup won't duplicate — good. But if a tester changes the seeded task status, there is no re-sync of seed state; document that clearly for QA.
seed_data_creation: None additional. Test data (TEST_ prefixed projects, TEST_UI_Project via UI, one AI photo analysis attached to seeded project) cleaned up during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_phase1.py (Phase 1) and /app/backend/tests/test_photos.py (Phase 0 photos, updated to login first). Both use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var — must be exported when running pytest (not read from frontend/.env automatically). One real AI call per full test run inside test_phase1.py::TestPhotos::test_photo_analyze_with_project_and_filter. Seeded project 'Residence – Ballarat West' 13% progress is the invariant to check. Do NOT run brute-force with the seeded email — use nonexistent email for wrong-password tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The dashboard 0-stats flash is a pre-fetch initial render and the missing-badge count in the first UI test was an artefact of the test toggling an already-expanded Stage 2 back closed, not a product bug.
